# Summary

## Concepts

Review how the RISC-V ISA, processor microarchitecture, and SoC architecture connect to verification and physical implementation.

## Implementation

Bring together the SystemVerilog designs and CORE-V Wally case studies developed throughout the book.

## Hands-on Experiments

Consolidate the reproducible experiments into an end-to-end SoC project. Compare simulation, FPGA, and ASIC implementation results, explaining the assumptions and limitations of each measurement.
